<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The task has progressed successfully. Alison has found a time and booked the meeting. My remaining responsibility is to send the confirmation email to the partners.

The slot Alison booked is Thursday at 15:00. I need to formulate a clear and professional confirmation email and send it using the `send_confirmation_email` function.

The email should include:
- The purpose of the meeting (Partners' Meeting).
- The date (Thursday, November 19, 2026).
- The time (15:00 Eastern Time).
- The duration (30 minutes).

I will now construct the email body and call the function. This should be the final action required from my side to complete the task.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
